title: Festival stats
subtitle: Who got the songs? Song time, cast time and what changed between days for multi-franchise lives.
no_events: No multi-franchise event with a setlist yet.
lineup_unknown: No official lineup in the data: performers are read from the setlist only.
f_song_time: Song time: {{top}} had the most ({{topVal}}), {{low}} the least ({{lowVal}}).
f_cast_time: Cast time per member: {{top}} members averaged {{topVal}} songs, {{low}} members {{lowVal}} ({{ratio}}×).
f_push: Push check: {{top}} sits {{topVs}} vs the average member and {{low}} {{lowVs}}.
f_collab: Collab: {{song}}% of song time and {{cast}}% of cast time was performed together with another franchise.
f_fair: Fairness: the 10 most-used performers took {{top10}}% of cast time (even split = {{even}}%); Gini {{gini}}.
s_song_time_lead: What was performed, counted by song. Each song is billed in full to its own franchise and weighted (full 1, long short ¾, TV/short ½, medley bit ⅓).
h_stack: Song time by franchise, split by original song type
flow_lead: Every song in order. Height = weight, colours = the franchises performing it.
s_cast_time_lead: Who was on stage, counted by person. Everyone performing a song gets its full weight.
h_dots: Average songs per member, by franchise
dots_lead: Dot = average, ends = least and most. Guests left out.
h_collab: How much of it was collab?
collab_lead: Collab = a song where the people on stage come from more than one franchise.
performers_lead: The darker part is songs performed together with another franchise.
s_push_lead: Is any franchise getting more than its share? Active franchises only. Tick “hide all-cast songs” so group numbers don't flatten everyone.
fair_text: The 10 most-used performers took {{top10}}% of all cast time (an even split would be {{even}}%). Gini {{gini}}: 0 means everyone got the same, 1 means one person got everything; under 0.2 is very even.
s_changes_lead: A song counts as changed only if the next day does not play it at all. Moving it is not a change.
shift_lead: Earlier day (hollow) → later day (filled). Green = more song time.
h_bump: The two running orders, side by side
bump_lead: Each line joins a song played on both days. ✕ = dropped, + = new. Hover to follow a song, click for details.
s_data_lead: Every performer and every song for the selected view.
m_lineup: Lineup: the official 出演者 list on the tour (named cast; group-only lines use the largest member list the data has for that group).
m_who: Who sang each song: names in the setlist remark; else the remark's version label (B.G.P., 1〜3期生) via the data's member lists; else the credited artist's members.
m_weight: Weights: full 1 · 1番→ラスサビ-type short ¾ · TV size / Movie size / short ½ · medley bit ⅓. Movie Edit counts as full. Hand corrections live in data/show-overrides.json.
m_billing: Billing: each song goes to its own franchise. Songs from several series with no single home go to Others. Original type comes from the credited artist, not from who performed.
m_data: Everything is read from the LLFans setlists in the bundled data: it matches that data, not necessarily what happened on stage. One show per day is a small sample, so the push check is a hint, not a verdict.
infographic_link_text: Song time, cast time, collab share and what changed between days for multi-franchise lives like ラブライブ！フェス.
